name: Village At Bachman Lake
summary: Village at Bachman Lake is a neighborhood community shopping center on Northwest Highway in Dallas, serving local residents with convenient access to retail, dining, and services. The center maintains a strong community presence with its accessible location near Bachman Lake Park and mix of everyday shopping options.
demographics: Village at Bachman Lake serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in northwest Dallas, drawing from surrounding residential neighborhoods with a mix of young families, working professionals, and established households. The trade area includes a significant Hispanic population along with multi-generational families seeking convenient neighborhood shopping options. Primary visitors are value-conscious shoppers looking for everyday necessities, services, and dining options within a 3-5 mile radius, with typical household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $75,000 annually.
description: Village at Bachman Lake is a well-established community shopping center located at 3701 West Northwest Highway in Dallas, Texas, serving the northwest Dallas corridor near Bachman Lake Park. This neighborhood retail destination has been a fixture in the area for decades, providing convenient access to essential shopping, dining, and services for local residents. The center maintains strong community ties with its mix of national retailers and local businesses that cater to the everyday needs of surrounding neighborhoods. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Village at Bachman Lake offers accessibility and convenience for working families and residents throughout the week. The center's strategic location along Northwest Highway ensures high visibility and easy access, while its proximity to Bachman Lake Park and nearby residential areas makes it a natural gathering point for the community.
